projectDescription: A UE5 editor plugin that brings Blender-style object manipulation (grab, rotate, scale with axis locking and numeric input) into the Unreal Engine viewport.
keyFeatures: Modal mode toggled via toolbar button — activate/deactivate Blender-style controls without affecting normal UE5 input
Grab (G), Rotate (R), Scale (S) transform modes matching Blender's keyboard shortcuts
Axis locking via X, Y, Z keys during any active transform
Numeric input — type a value and press Enter/Space to apply a precise transformation
Mouse-driven screen-space manipulation as an alternative to numeric input
Left-click to confirm, Right-click or Escape to cancel any in-progress transform
Works on multiple selected actors simultaneously
Zero-configuration: ships as a standard UE5 Editor plugin with no external dependencies
publicApiSurface: FBlenderInputHandler::HandleKeyDownEvent() — processes G/R/S, X/Y/Z, numeric, Enter, Escape
EBlenderTransformMode enum: None, Grab, Rotate, Scale
EBlenderTransformAxis enum: None, X, Y, Z, All
